The Nature of Devotion to God

What do we understand when we say devotion? Say what you know. Let it be understood by you. You have devotion. But there is also the problem of not knowing how to practice it. You have devotion. How will you explain to someone what that devotion is like? Devotion is absolutely a kind of love, isn't it? The next goal is to know towards what that love is directed. Now, one who worships the Mother will give all his love to the Mother. Isn't it? Otherwise, the one who worships the Son will give it there. Whatever it may be. Thus, one sees God in the acts of the Mother and the Father. Isn't it? So, it is said Mother and Father. Now, according to our reasoning, it is the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Isn't it? So, when we say the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, how can it be understood? Say it as you know it. We should stand firm in what we have learned and do everything accordingly. That is our success.

Now, don’t people talk about the logic of the Hindu, the logic of Islam, the logic of the Christian, the logic of the Jain, and the logic of the Buddhist? Every logic is a doctrine itself. We have to see how far it goes. We don’t know how far it goes. Why? Because we have not understood what the nature of spiritual merit or spiritual happiness is. This is the reason. One religion says there is no rebirth, another says there is, and then there is the matter of the prophets. There is this so-called prophethood of the prophets, isn’t there? Don’t they say it became twenty-five, thirty-five, sixty-five, etc.? If this prophetic religion says there is no rebirth, then why say it is the umpteenth prophet? Don’t they say there is no rebirth? Then what is the reason for this to happen like this? So, if a prophet comes, there is a logic in that. We just don’t know that logic. So, there are ten, a hundred, or even a thousand yugas (epochs). But we don’t even know that these yugas exist. So what do we do? Then whatever we see, we go after that. Right? Isn’t that so? So, the guru is the one who comes and tells us according to the dharma of the yuga. So, for one person, he says two thousand years. Jesus says two thousand, the Prophet says one thousand five hundred, and for Buddha, it is not said how much. Buddha said there is no karma and just dismissed it. If he said there is no karma, then this Buddha's body shouldn't accept anything, right? Because hasn't it been said that there is no karma if something is given? Then if something is bought and given for hunger, can anything come in it? Hasn't karma been cut off? Didn't understand. Buddha said there is absolutely no karma. He dismisses all that saying 'bhe, bhe, bhe'. If he dismisses it like that, how can we catch that stream of light of karma according to this yugadharma? We won't be able to catch it. Because it happened like this, however many people we call our ancestors, all of them have made a mistake. That is why Jesus had to die on the cross. This is exactly why the Prophet in his last days had to go thirsty wondering why he was sent like this. The thought was that if this body could be discarded somehow, it would be enough; it couldn't be crossed over—that was the thought. For that, he sat in that prayer itself, sitting like that constantly, and for three months he did a bhajan—that's what they say. That is, don't they take a vow for ninety days, they say it as a bhajan. For those three months, he sat right there, getting up and sitting down, getting up and sitting down, and prayed. This is prayer. Then moving from there to over there is only for number one or number two (answering nature's call). Then he won't touch water, won't eat anything, and if anyone brings and gives him anything, he won't take it. Why? Because he became a body that came wrongly. Understood? So, whatever things I have known and made known so far have gone wrong. They don't say this. This is exactly what Jesus also says. They don't say this. So, when a person's two thousand years are over, it is said that everything is over. Then if only six thousand or seven thousand years are mentioned in total, it is based on the calculation of this visionary mentioned. That is what history says about this Imam and other things. If it happens like this, we should not assume that this karma is over. However much a prophet has grown, he will be brought to that position and stopped. From there, the start must be according to the dharma of this yuga. The guru must be someone who knows that yugadharma. You cannot know this. You shouldn't go for that. If someone gives you bread, do you ask how much bread he has baked before eating it? You won't say a word. So, in that way, we are dedicating ourselves. My karma up to today and what is going to come tomorrow is the karma for the functioning capacity of my life-force (jeevan). Keep in yourself the functioning capacity of that life-force as long as it lasts. Otherwise, there is no point in keeping it. So, it is being kept in you. So, when we dedicate it like this, it's like a wrestling match between our jeevan and this prana, isn't the prana being beaten up so that the jeevan is torn away? How is that? At the time of death ٹ . won't it flutter like this? That is the ٹ of prana. So, the work being done is to tear away the jeevan from this. Right? So, what do they say about it, a certain group of people who come? Drawing it in through the nose, taking it to the head, bringing it down from the head to the kundalini here, and playing with it by moving it back and forth from there. He assumes that it has become complete. But this won't be right. This will only suit his bodily functions. This is not a guru. Whatever births we have taken, whatever karmas we have done, when we submit all of this over there, it will all untie from the first and come in front of you, like garbage. Then what to do? Submit that too, I don't want anything. And then, the feet called your charanaravindam ٹ at those feet - we must see the feet covered by this light. We must fall at those feet and bow down. I cannot do it, father, whatever else there is, it's for you. So, we grow in this path of light. Then the light of that guru strikes us in many ways like this. So, surrender everything in this. When this surrender happens, we will be troubled. But why does it happen like this, I will tell you, you must ask. It's like this, it doesn't matter, let it go, we should have the strength to go by the word of that guru. Why is itٹ I will not take this upٹ Like that, we must catch hold of this light and bring it. This is Brahmacharya.

Brahmacharya means that this light is always in our heart and all parts of the body, or without our knowledge, now, take this hair for instance. I don't have hair now. What to do? For people with hair, whatever hair they have, this enters through the tip of that hair, understood? That is the thing. So it enters and our mind, words, and actions become completely filled. When it fills up, we surrender saying, "Oh God, everything is yours" - this attitude of Brahmacharya is this surrendering. Did you understand now? This is Brahmacharya. This light is shining upon us. When this light shines, it is said that this old birth of ours does not exist.

It has been logically said that one has no birth, one has no karma, one has nothing else, and so on. With all this logic, this mind will not settle and stay there. If it does, tell me. Will swallowing poison prove and change that? Our yogisٹ as many yogis have shown through karma, that pranayama, which means controlling the prana and uniting it with the soul, is what is prescribed. If it is united like that, does it mean this prana's karma is exhausted? It is not going to end like that. This is Brahmacharya. If it is to end, where should it be offered? This prana and the soul's karma should be offered to one's Guru and released there. If offered anywhere else, it will not go. Understood? Now I had an absurd thought. What to do? Offer that too? Good things came. Offer that too. Our physical life, as long as we exist, will be exhausted through karma. Whether it is bad karma or good karma, whatever it is, I must exhaust it through you. I will do what I have to do, with this karma of mine. Karma means the body. So, with this body, whatever I can doٹ I don't know anything else. When this surrender happens, it will stir this mind of ours. It will churn like churning curd. Things will rise and fall. Then, staying firmly there--when it is churned and this butter becomes clear, its turbidity will be removed, right? Then it can only be churned in the milk obtained the next day, right? So, churning each time, it becomes clear. This is it, understood now? Even if I say many things, it won't get across to you. The reason I said this must be told is like this. That is our karma. Do you understand now why I said "let me see"? Because of that, if you say I can't bear it, can't sit, can't lie down, it will only increase. Understood? This is devotion. Just offer it. There is no 'we', it's either you or me. Who is it? If the Guru is there, then you are not there, right? What did you understand? You have offered everything of yours. Then who is there? Only the Guru. Let the Guru show what he is. You just keep quiet. Even if some sense is advised, it won't listen, this. It should be beaten and made to sit there. This is the task. How to give that beating? One's extreme flaw--or some extreme devotion or whatever it is, this will come. Everyone will understand it differently. Let it be anyway. All of them will get something. They will take something according to their intellect. That is its way. If a mistake happens like that, then, why did it happen to me, it is such and such. It doesn't matterٹ When it is said that it doesn't matter, in the sense that the Guru's word has taken effect, then nothing matters. Like that, the Guru will just reject everything. Understood now? It must be extinguished in this Guru's light. That is the correct way. Then this light settles into oneself. When it settles and becomes complete, are you there anymore? Then only that exists. That's it. If you are there, I am not. If I am there, you are not. Shouldn't it be like that? That's it. This should be learned from childhood itself. Otherwise, getting old and hunchbacked, calling 'Hey', if that's enough, fine. Is it enough? No. Alright then. Keep calling. Always keep calling. Inside us, within our heart, the whole body can be seen. But not that, within the heart, the Guru can be seen. That is how it should come. Right? The feet will be seen in our heart. Those are the dust of the feet. Then in that stream of light, we merge. Coming into the heart--it is not just the feet that come, when everything comes and resides there, what will you do? With this concept, it became within our Guru. Or the Guru became within us. What to do? There will be happiness. At the same time, what if we deal with unnecessary things? One shouldn't say that one shouldn't go like that. That is the mistake. Surrender it. After surrendering, if you see it didn't work--you and the Guru are sitting together. When you and the Guru are sitting together--is this how you sit? Sit straight. If the Guru and you sit together, it is absolute perfection. But what is it? Will not speak to anyone. Without speaking like that, my flaws will be offered at that Guru's feet and destroyed. Otherwise, if this is pushed and thrown out, what to do? Let everyone come. Come and offer it at this Guru's feet and destroy it. Set it on fire. Understood now? This is Brahmacharya. This is not how it is brought about. I made everything come, didn't I say let everything come to you? This coming is for this. After coming like this, this Guru will be inside you. Shouldn't that merge? Shouldn't it become motionless? How will that happen? When these stains of our life come, Guruٹ the Guru and you together hold and break it. See, it catches fire. Do you see this gathering? It is like this for us. Otherwise, we sit outside. Or isn't it lying elsewhere. Then it will be seen inside and outside us. It will be seen in everything. Seeing it in everything like that, you became the Guru again. It became only the Guru and you. There is no Guru at all. Or there is no you at all. Don't convince people by saying great Vedanta. This is the task. If you see that all this is gone, it is Maya, none of this exists, then through creative karma, Jagrat (waking), Swapna (dreaming), Sushupti (deep sleep), Turiya, and Turiyatita—passing through these five stages, the Guru stands in all those places and breaks them. This is the Guru. So it won't be the same path for everyone. Some in karma vasana (tendency for action), some others in jnana vasana (tendency for knowledge), some others, it would be this mentioned devotion, what we just discussed. The subject of devotion, everything offered within. And then you and the Guru stay as one. Who will this ultimately become? When you and the Guru become one, what happens? Come through whichever karma you want. You and the Guru will become one. When one karma is over, you and the Guru become one again. Understood? This is like a stream of light. This is what these Muslims call Noor Khan. Like this, there are hundreds of lights. This light is merging into us like this. After all this merges, there is no such thing as 'I'. When it becomes like that, our emotions, voids, and evils will all merge into this. Then the Guru will have some trouble, pain, and obligations. That is usual. Why? Didn't I say earlier, what is it? Hey, didn't he come for that. When you say Guru, didn't he come for that. Let him take it. What is it to you? Then if you want, you can pray a lot after he has taken it. Pray thinking of the Guru himself, to break this for you. What? That is its logic. So in this, there is another trick. Seeing the whole world and then seeing it in one's heart. Or seeing it in one's body. This Guru and you will expand and become this entire world. Understood? It shrinks like that and remains like an atom. These many thousands of suns and moons, stars, all these will come inside oneself. That means the jiva (soul) must grasp it. The jiva should grasp it and give it back. Like that, grasping each, only the Guru can release it. That is why it is said to catch hold of the Guru. From there, the Guru might sometimes give conversations, give words. After a while, that word becomes insufficient. What is it? There was a system called this writing on the floor, during our early days. You might not have heard of it. Have you heard of Ashan (teacher)? When these kids get angry, they will call the Ashan "kiyo". You haven't been able to hear it. Karunagappally, if you go to Karthikappally, it is still there. Rr, n all these will come. All of them will get together. In between, saying 'r'. That is why the writing teacher is called 'Keer'. Like this, the teacher and oneself became one. See the act of tearing the teacher. This is not said lightly. In this, the teacher will also tear, the disciple will also tear, this is it.

Therefore, when we speak of the soul, or the spiritual merit of the soul (*Athmasukrutham*), there are individual souls (*Jivatmas*) that have attained immense spiritual merit. We must comprehend each of these. Not everyone possesses it—that is the rationale in our perspective. What have you understood? Speak; have you not been traversing this path for quite some time? Do we not speak of entities such as a *Deva*, *Devi*, *Rishi*, or *Sanyasi*? We are attempting to grasp that. All of them. What is the evidence for this? State something. Once you and the Guru become fundamentally united, what follows?

"The inner mind must become like a focused gaze." Do you observe? We will begin to perceive everything within our inner consciousness just as we see with our physical eyes. The trajectory that ascends from that state is the Guru. It is in this context that it is said that you and I are one, and that it is sheer bliss—it implies that you are the Truth and I am the Bliss. I am the one experiencing the bliss. You are the Truth. You are to remain established there. Hearing this alone will not yield comprehension. It is stated that you are the Truth, not Knowledge (*Jnana*). I am the Bliss. Consequently, this Truth is rejoicing, both internally and externally. "The inner mind must become like a focused gaze and become motionless within you." It must completely merge. Once absorbed in such a spiritual practice (*Karma*), we encounter multiple cosmic planes (*Akashas*). Do we not currently have a firmament surrounding the Earth? Similarly, for every planet—is there not a surrounding space? Is it not around us as well? Does it not encompass all these entities? Likewise, this cosmic expanse—encompassing absolutely everything—constitutes a solar system. In that solar system, oneself and the Guru reside as a unified entity. What is to be done? This is the methodology to comprehend the Guru. Grasping anything else will not yield results. If you inquire about this to someone devoid of spiritual experience, they will advise you to discard all of this. Where can it be discarded? Where exactly is this being discarded? Is what is being proposed even practically attainable? Where is it being discarded? This is precisely what is unattainable. Therefore, you need not discard it. Neither should you acquire it, nor give it away. You must remain steadfast in a spirit of absolute surrender. My Guru is not distinct from me. Alternatively, there is no separate entity as "oneself." Only the Guru exists. Thus, when situated as the Guru, let the Guru act according to His divine will. "I" do not exist—I will not do anything claiming it as "mine." Is it not clear? What will not be done? I do not desire any of these corrupted paths. You may take them. This is the underlying principle.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Dedication Edition 2003
The Discourse Delivered by the Guru to the People of Thalassery

As epochs and centuries have progressively elapsed, profound transmutations in states of being (*Avasthabhedangal*) have emerged. When discussing these transmutations, everything from a demonic entity (*Pishachu*) to a divine being (*Deva*) represents a specific state of our existence. Regarding these specific states, there are individuals who worship a deity (*Deva*), attain the state of that deity, and subsequently pass away. Subordinate to that, do we not have numerous people in our region who worship entities like *Yakshis*, ghouls (*Pey*), and *Karinkuttichathan*? Thus, many have lived embodying various forms of worship, such as that of *Muthappan*. Furthermore, there is a tradition of invoking deities like Subramanya in this manner. All of these are factual. None of this is non-existent. It exists. It is also what our ancestors venerated. How do we transcend this? If transcended through Yoga—the Yoga referred to here is not the Yoga as we conventionally understand it today. Here, Yoga denotes *Rajayoga*. The others are categorized as *Hathayoga*, *Hamsayoga*, *Chandrikayoga*, and so forth. There is no *Pranayama* involved in this. In this *Rajayoga*, there is neither *Pranayama* nor the practice of restraining the vital breath. Upon hearing these accounts, we have assumed this to be the supreme path and have placed our faith in that spiritual practice (*Karma*), which was demonstrated in some distant *Treta Yuga*. That was transmitted through the *Treta* and *Dwapara Yugas*, and we continue to practice the very same methods today. This does not require alteration in the *Satya Yuga*. During the *Satya Yuga*, human conduct is maximally aligned with truth. Having divided these epochs, we now refer to a *Chaturyuga* comprising four distinct periods. Among these four periods, the shortest is the era of *Kali*. This spans 4,32,000 years. Its double is *Dwapara*, and the double of that is the *Treta Yuga*. Therefore, by the time we traverse the *Dwapara* and such vast expanses of time, our practical existential conditions undergo complete transformation. For this reason, spiritual preceptors (*Acharyas*) must manifest periodically. Only they possess the capacity to rectify this course. This cannot be sustained by a mere Yogi, a ritualist (*Karmi*), or the ordinary spiritual practice that claims everything is fulfilled upon a mere manifestation. The manifestation of a *Deva*, *Devi*, or *Rishi* is no longer sufficient. Their respective eras have concluded. What, then, is the current paradigm? You must comprehend this. When dealing with matters of this nature, if you do not gradually inquire and learn, merely attending will yield no benefit. You will fail to understand it entirely. Presently, we have attained the state of a demonic entity (*Pishachu*) and have been perpetuating its worship as our tradition. We are subordinated to this *Pishachu*. We have been practicing this, misinterpreting it as a deity (*Deva*). We have worshipped and fortified it over many epochs. How can it vanish simply by declaring it non-existent? Therefore, rather than habitually denying its existence, acknowledge that it exists. However, to what extent, and in what manner? This is the core issue concerning the transition of states (*Avasthantharabhēdam*). Thus, when discussing this transition of states, the initial aspect we must determine is how we completed a specific state, or a level, and through what means we achieved that completion? That is one facet of it. Consequently, there are four paths: the Yogi, the *Karmi*, the *Jnani*, and the *Bhakta*. There was an epoch traversed by the Yogi. One must not cling to that epoch now. For what reason? That must be understood. The era of the Yogi is the path where a human evolves, transforms into a *Deva*, transforms into a *Rishi*, transforms into a *Sanyasi*, and ultimately achieves liberation as a *Jnani*. The *Deva* is not at the forefront. Therefore, the human being inherently possesses the potential to become the *Deva*, the *Rishi*, and the *Sanyasi*. Regarding our modes of worship, we inherit a tradition that continues with practices like sacred serpent groves (*Sarppakavu*) and similar localized ritualistic consecrations (*Vaccharadhana*). It cannot be stated that these do not exist. They do exist. The objective is to discern to what extent and in what manner this existing reality should be worshipped to reach completion. Reaching a certain state intrinsically necessitates divine vision (*Darshana*). We remain ignorant of the forms or variations we have traversed within a single lifetime. Why, then, should one ponder over it? There is an immense multitude of transitional states. How should one rationalize and discard them? There are proponents of non-dualism (*Advaitins*) who question the utility of contemplating such matters. To speak as a true *Advaitin*, one must be an individual who has successfully transcended these transitional states. Others do not possess the authority to assert this. Ignorant of these realities, relying solely on human intellect, capability, and inherent human actions, we acquire wealth and knowledge, celebrating and reveling without comprehending the transitional states, only to eventually perish. I am uncertain of what you have comprehended from this. What have you understood thus far? It is inadequate for me to merely continue speaking in this manner. You must attain comprehension. Only when you comprehend to our level can we progress forward. Let us simply impart what we have realized.

The current era is indeed Kali Yuga. There is no point in looking back anymore. All that is past. Having arrived at the dharma of this Kali Yuga, God Himself has brought a multitude of gurus and prophets into it. Therefore, the dharma of our Kali Yuga is to evaluate the rights and wrongs traversed across numerous past lives. What does that mean for one's life? How will we understand it? You must comprehend this. We need to perceive and understand the evolutionary nature of life that has taken form even as a mere worm. How is that possible? We cannot meticulously sift through everything like that. I am not telling you to do this. You need not even think about it. If you think about it, you will feel distressed. Yet, you cannot avoid thinking about it either. Why? Having the realization that 'I am the evolutionary product of a life force that originated from such lower depths' is a characteristic of our human intellect. Even just to become human, it implies this is difficult. Then, don't we say, 'He behaves like a bull?' In that case, he remains in an ordinal state equivalent to a bull. No, this is the birth he took as a human. It is the karma of having lived like an animal, now standing as a human. But he only possesses the physical form of a human. It has evolved through various forms. Taking human incarnations across several ages and progressing to a state where this human's capacity for karma attains liberation is what constitutes a change of state. However, he is born as a human. One might ask, 'Are not all these humans actually human?' True. In practice, all are humans. There is no life force that is otherwise. Now we have taken a birth. We worshipped a lot, committed bad deeds, did good deeds, engaged in unwanted actions, and performed everything. What will this life force do? It will go and merge. Therefore, we carry the legacy of worshipping everything, starting from demons, in our hands. Will it not manifest the latent tendencies of that life? The vasana acquired through birth is merely that of being human. The soul does not change. It remains the same. It is merely a process undergoing transformation. For that, you should do this. There are children who only pass nursery. Then there are children who leave without studying anything. There are those who study, mess everything up, wander around, and die like animals. There are also those who study, succeed in all aspects, and move forward. Is that not merely a human pattern? What follows are the dynamics and trajectories of a virtuous soul that has transcended this human pattern. You need not go searching for this. Why? Because you are fortunate to be born in Kali Yuga. Why did we attain such fortune? Be it any animal, attaining the fortune to be born in this Kali Yuga signifies salvation even for those akin to animals; it is liberation. Liberated from one state to another. This is the distinctiveness of Kali Yuga. We were not made aware of the dharma of the times. We were subjugated by being made to believe that Kali is no good. Who declared that Kali is unfavorable for humanity as a whole? Whether it was a Vedic scholar or anyone else. If one celebrates Vedanta by professing grand theories, is it beneficial for the soul? This is proof of that. As I mentioned yesterday, these are doctrines. Calling every yogic practice Raja Yoga and otherwise is not what it is. What is meant by Raja Yoga? A wealthy person, without his knowledge at birth, is born wealthy. Then, despite being born so, he continues to seek great positions. Someone else is born into a poor family. He too might search, search, and search, eventually finding a path. Another person, on the contrary, is born wealthy but turns into a beggar. This is the change of state. You must understand this much. You do not need to listen to any other justifications. The reason is, since the era you are born in is Kali Yuga, you will possess the karmic capacity to follow the path of a guru. It arises naturally. However, understanding what a guru is, what a deity is, what a sage is, what an ascetic is, what a wise person is, what ancestors are, and what the distinct imagination of those ancestors is—this continuous realization constitutes the change of state. Then comes the question of how many births I have taken in this process of transformation. See, this is what you witness. Thus, in what you see, we observe various things: my father, my mother, my husband, my wife, my children, wealth, achievements. Isn't it? Why should this be shown like this? Do you understand my difficulty in the fact that you came only to run away? It is not enough for you to somehow get consent and leave. The issue is that you do not understand this. Places that explain this are rare. Agreed. But we do have the conviction that this exists. Don't we need a karmic capacity aligned with the truth, which we should exercise based on that conviction? Will it suffice if I decide to acquire it after this lifetime? Another thing we have been told is that during childhood, children do not need any of this. It is said that when one ages, all these changes of state occur—what are they? Changes of the body, not the mind. When the physical state changes, they say one just needs to go lie down somewhere and chant. They won't be able to stand and chant. The story we have been made to believe is that if one chants like that, God will come running. They fabricated a story for this, calling it Ajamila Moksham. What can we do about the ignorance entangled within that? This is knowledge that is not true knowledge. These are the blunders that have befallen you, me, and anyone else who has been born, come, and gone. If you ask for proof of this, I am not just telling you. Within your children and within yourself, we acquire an understanding of what the states of wakefulness (Jagrat), dream (Swapna), and deep sleep (Sushupti) are. I slept well yesterday. That is a piece of knowledge. Isn't it? We slept. The realization that we slept is knowledge, right? In reality, we must be convinced that we slept well and rested. Is this right or wrong? We see the exact same thing in dreams. We go to certain places, behave in certain ways, do bad things, do good things, do this and that, acting in various inexplicable ways. We do not know what this is. So, it is shown in the dream itself using the language of the waking state. It's like, 'I had a lot of terrifying dreams.' This might happen due to the magnitude of the demon we worshipped. So, if we revere this as God, are we not still demons!

Whether it is called Calcutta Kali, or whatever Kali-like characteristics are thus described, none of this is Kali. Do not assume it to be Kali. This is merely a specific function of a form constructed within a specific human intellect. Many among them danced in such a frenzy and perished. This ascends into the atmosphere and remains exactly as it is. We are born in this alignment. Thus, everything becomes comprehensible then, doesn't it? Is it clear to you? Therefore, conditioning these children by speaking in this manner, teaching them that God is everything without them comprehending what a deity, goddess, sage, or ascetic truly is, is a peculiar manifestation of ignorance. We fall into this and rot away. What can I do if you fail to understand it this way? Whether you are a small child, an adult, or even 100 years old, if you do not comprehend this distinction, there is no purpose in your living as a human being. We may possess money, capability, wealth, and power. All of that is merely the residue of what we invoked at some point for the sake of a father, mother, husband, children, money, or wealth. None of this will save you. Tell me if it does. For instance, if the affluent have some wealth and capability, we, the inhabitants of that household, lived somewhat decently. Or else, let them live as wretched beings, however they may. However they may live, they lack the robust health of the servant in the neighboring house. What is the reason? So, if this body is carefully preserved, wrapped up, and polished by sheer luck, hasn't the entirety of your life been wasted? What did you understand? Let karma be. Let karma be whatever it is. What has your life become? If the father and mother learned from observing this, they say, "Children, because the father was like this, we gained nothing. Because the mother was like that, we couldn't achieve anything." What occurs there is a mutual casting of blame. Then, speaking ill of the locals, the extended family, and everyone they encounter. Believing only we are good. Thus, accumulating the deficiencies of caste, human flaws, and all such shortcomings, exhibiting them, proclaiming the weight of a course of karma, and masquerading as great. Isn't this our presumed greatness! This is merely akin to the caste and class organizations of today. What is each of you saying? "It is our organization." Of what? Whose is it? Which constitutes "us"? Doesn't "we" imply everyone collectively? How did it become exclusively "us" within that framework? There exists an exclusive "us" there. They are flaunting themselves, standing at the extremity of the course of karma accumulated in this state. Will this grant you spiritual merit, virtuous deeds, or anything else? What are you doing? Now, Narayana Guru resigned from the S.N.D.P. Yogam. For what reason? You claim that Narayana Guru Swami was the one who founded the S.N.D.P. Yogam. Chattampi Swami is the author of *Vedadhikara Nirupanam*. He did not impart a culture of criticism dictated by the authority of the Vedas. Just because we criticize it, do we become that? Sri Shankara has expounded on Advaita. Will we become that? What are you contemplating? Is there any salvation for us if we worship deities and goddesses and perish beneath them? Without explaining any of this to us as a differentiation in states, our girls become infatuated with something, fall into it and decay, and are raised to be utterly worthless, bound and untied. Will you be pleased when I articulate this? Is this confined to my house? Does it exist in your house too? Dancing in such masquerades, bull-dancing—isn't "bull" (*kaala*) the term used? It is not "college," is it? You are going to college, correct? Towards the south, it is pronounced "*kaalege*" (bull-age). In your region, it might be called "college." But this is not the case. They are attending "*kaalege*." So, arriving here dancing like this bull, the ensuing behavior is also that of this bull. This is a masquerade of the Western mode of living. How will you or I break free from this? Can you alter your children? Can you change, can I change, can anyone in the world undergo transformation? Why do you remain silent? With this becoming corrupted and evolving into labor and the labor of labor, formidable rulers extract revenue from foreign territories, transfer it to their nations, impose their sovereign authority over us, and demand what is termed tribute. What is this tribute? "Paying tribute" is its accurate designation. That is to say, it is not a tax. They waged war and conquered our nation. Once subjugated, under the illusion that they will govern our country, we have surrendered and are singing their praises. It is quantified in so many lakhs, so many crores. So, within this karma that has transiently occurred, isn't this all we have become accustomed to? Subsequently, when they ascended to the position of imperial rulers, what atrocities did they perpetrate? Which aggressors did they employ to execute them, and which emperors have flourished by ruling through such oppression? This is how successive governments emerge. Aren't they the ones dispensing all the buttermilk and milk today, who exactly is it? Whoever it may be. Why are they providing it? Thus, as we hear, observe, and recognize this, the individual designated as the capitalist there extracts tribute in this manner, educates the youth of his nation, manufactures these machines, supplies them back to us, appropriates that wealth, and even issues grants. Is this the reality or not? Observing this, what would be the consequence if the local capitalist seized this grant? Does he require anything further to be utterly ruined? The laborers are predominantly impoverished. They are completely oblivious. The commodities they purchase from here for 8 cash or 10 rupees are sold there for 10,000 rupees. Such is the certainty. However, when the labor wages, the corporate operations, the corporate remuneration, and the logistical expenses are all accounted for, what do this capitalist and this worker truly gain? Can an individual lacking at least crores in wealth disburse this allowance? Consequently, without the laborers comprehending this, the item we supply for one rupee is sold there for 101 rupees. Furthermore, our commodities are subjected to an alternative methodology. When the premium goods arrive there, they are sold at a depreciated price to ascertain the valuation of our nation. Upon whose shoulders does this burden rest? Therefore, isn't it an undeniable truth that we are harboring detriment in the karma we execute with absolute awareness? This constitutes administration. This is the nature of oppressive governance. And subsequently, all these rulers have congregated and instituted a democracy. That is represented by this bank possessing an international character. Isn't it? Is that not the case? If we withdraw capital from this bank, will we become affluent once more? We will be devastated. We will become perpetually indebted. This epitomizes our contemporary predicament. Similarly, what we designate as this differentiation in states, and those who venerated this demonic entity, constitute the vast majority. Then there are those who departed invoking the deity. Some others invoked asserting that everything else is valid. Others proclaiming nothing is valid, all of this is a fabrication. Which perspective is correct? If our offspring observe and assimilate all this, will the children ever attain salvation? If you can articulate it, tell me. As long as this child remains unsaved, we are confined in that penitentiary. What did you deduce? This child transforms into, firstly, a simpleton; secondly, an embodiment of absolute malpractices; thirdly, a fertile ground for devastation. With all these three obliterated, there is no salvation; does there exist any avenue for the ancestors, who have traversed through salvation, to be redeemed? You are entirely devoid of contemplation. That is precisely it; if you approach in haste to depart, I cannot elucidate anything to you. This is not what you require. You have squandered an exorbitant amount of time indulging in children, husband, wife, lordship, and education. How profoundly you have struggled for the betterment of your existence. I am not directing you along the path I delineated previously. Conversely, I am not merely singing melodies to you. You must comprehend that. Am I merely gratifying you by singing melodies? It is an arduous struggle; existence itself is an arduous struggle. For us, born exclusively into a course of karma subsisting as male or female, isn't the existence of each one of us consummated by integrating the ignorance and knowledge of this male and female? Whether it manifests as a child, an adult, a grandfather, or a grandmother. When it manifests, isn't it identical? Even if it perishes and decays, isn't it identical? I am inquiring whether you comprehend this. I am not discoursing Vedanta to you. If I have articulated any Vedanta, you must declare it now. Pertaining to this, there exists a profound distance for you. Nevertheless, it is intimately proximate. Why is that so? I am revealing one reality to you. You are receiving it both unconsciously and consciously. This
Jagrat swapnasushupteenam
Sakshipoorthi namo namah

In the waking state, after seeing all these demons, one sees the Guru. It is the same in dreams. It is the same in deep sleep. This means the Guru catches it. So we were leading the worst kind of life. All of this is being seen. The worst possible behaviors were being shown. All of that is being seen. Then, returning, one sees the Guru again. One takes up the karma from that Guru and moves forward. Thus, this is a secret between the Guru and the disciple. It is the secret of secrets; that is *Guhyat guhyataram*. That is what the author of the Gita says. Other than the author of the Gita, no one else has brought this to light. This is the truth. Without understanding this truth, you follow poets and learn the story of making it 16008. But you never truly understood what it is. What did you understand from this? Aren't you all family people and members of society? Tell me, what did you understand? You should be teaching this to the children. That is why I am asking this. What did you understand? Unless you men understand this strongly, this will not leave the hands of these women. You absolutely must understand it. Now, we can only raise our daughter, bring her to a certain level, and send her away. Upon going there, she will also deal with the very same things. What will you do with her? If necessary, if even a spadeful of soil is moved, it immediately leads to stabbing, killing, and axes. Isn't this what you are accumulating? The elder sister was given like that, the elder brother was given like that, for me like that... what is it? Or it was given to your younger one, given to the elder one—it is a chaotic game of disputes. The question is how you are going to refine this. You are refining it. If you come here and leave, you should understand at least this much.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarpana Pathippu 2003
The Knowledge Spoken by History

In order to understand the essence of Yugadharma, these twenty-five Chaturyugas were utilized. Lord Rama or those who existed before him, all the Yugadharmas ٹ now Lord Rama is the one we can point out as an example. So, that Lord Rama was a prince. Everyone knows it like this. Then, through him, whatever he did, those things when brought into the royal system, his wisdom was lost. That is, the wise do not need to think about a king in that manner. Or is not highly educated , the king . A little education having been practiced or so, that is not how it comes, the fame of being a king . This into the Yuga system it has been brought entirely. In this Kali Yuga , the king will cease to exist on his own. The reason for that is that this king should become a Brahmajnani. If he is just picked up, made a king, and kept safely, how can he become a Brahmajnani? This, these householders do not understand either . And this Grihadharma is not fulfilled either . Because he is a great a householder ٹ , the king . By remaining a householder, indulging in all these and living a chaotic life, how can he become a Brahmajnani? And then, it is cleverly written elsewhere that the fallen yogis (Yogabhrashtas) are the ones who come as kings. That is also not correct.

What do we understand by the term Yoga? By Yoga, what we should understand is Rajayoga, Hamsayoga, Karmayoga, and Jnanayoga. So, a person who has become an authority in Jnanayoga is not going to become a Yogabhrashta (one who has fallen from Yoga). It is the others who become so. If others come, how would he know this? So, if you hear someone being called a Yogabhrashta, just believe it blindly. It is our ignorance; because those who learned and taught this Tantric knowledge preached that it is the Yogabhrashtas who are reborn as kings, the kings themselves became ignorant. An example of this is that the kings of the four states—the King of Mysore, the King of Kerala, the King of Kochi, and Pandi—were not these people. Who? They were not Kshatriyas. Therefore, four different types of ceremonies were established for these four groups. It is through this ceremony that our king emerges very cleverly. They invented a trick to make our king a true king—Hiranyagarbham. So, this festival of Tantras and Mantras is conducted for forty-one days, and during all these forty-one days, a Kalasham (sacred pot) is placed. It is made of various types of metals. It ranges from earthen pots to golden pots. The preparations for this are escalated like this, and we have been taught a story for that as well. Accordingly, one has to pass through the belly of a cow. This is the summary of it. Finally, when all these mantras and tantras are completed and the ritual of the golden kalasham arrives, it is fulfilled. This cow and all these things belong to the Tantri (head priest). They have made us listen and learn all this like a poem.

That is Naranathu Bhranthan. Because he was born to a Paraya woman and was taken and raised in another household, it was considered that he had no right to *Brahmagnana* (supreme knowledge). No one even knew that *Brahmagnana* could be attained in such a way. He then wandered around as Naranathu Bhranthan (the madman of Naranathu). What is called madness here is actually the state of an *Avadhuta* (a mystic who has transcended worldly consciousness). While he was making jokes and playing around, they took away all these things—this cow and the golden pot as well. So, even though they were children of the same mother, they went up to him and said, "Lord, the dead conch belongs to your servant." This means it is lifeless. How can one give life to a golden cow? As soon as that was said, the lord stepped down. The lord was that brilliant. It is said that when he plucked some grass and showed it to the cow, the cow stepped down and walked away. What kind of ill-fated people must they be to deceive us by telling such utter nonsense? So, this is our ignorance. Thus, in this poem and in similar ways, they have mocked us in every possible manner. In the olden days, Brahmins did not climb Sabarimala. Today, its monopoly of power is in their hands. Why is that? This Ayyappan, who was a worshipper of Chathan, went to the *samadhi* site of this Hariharan. When I say Hariharan, you might not understand. It was a son of the King of Pandalam who was named Hariharan. Sabarimala is the place where he went and attained *samadhi*. The place where Sabari performed penance. Beyond the place called Saramkuthiyal, there is an Appachimedu. Then, similarly, after passing this Saramkuthiyal, one directly ascends to Sabarimala. By operating this Sabarimala, Hariharan determined that his royal family should become like the lineage of the Buddha. But for that purpose, he performed penance, and among many other things, he went there. In those days, this land belonged to the King of Pandalam. Ayyappan went and sat there after digging a trench on all four sides of the place where he attained *samadhi*. If you pay attention to the name used to call Ayyappan, as they have said, you will understand it. But you do not know how to pay attention to it. He is called 'Hariharasuthan Ayyan Ayyappan'. That Hari is the aforementioned son of the king. 'Hariharasuthan' refers to the king's son himself. Having finalized that, what did it become when they kept saying it? Hariharasuthan Ayyan Ayyappan. So, they fabricated this story to make it seem like he was the son the king obtained to raise. Thus, spinning this story, he became Hariharasuthan Ayyan Ayyappan; he is Ayyan. Moreover, in Tamil, there is a prominent word 'Ayyan'. So they said it in a way that people wouldn't understand this: Hariharasuthan Ayyan Ayyappaswami. Thus, this is a Swami named Ayyappan, not the other one—Hariharan. So, having gone and sat there, in this state of *samadhi*, he ascended higher than Hariharan. That is when they consecrated him there, calling him Hariharan. But he is Ayyappan. This Ayyappan is from North Malabar. One cannot definitively say North Malabar. He is from near Ottapalam in Palakkad. It is only about six miles from there. So, such stories are coming to light even today. Ayyappan Kavu. There is an Ayyappan Kavu in Ernakulam. In this Ernakulam district itself, there is a place called Kanjiramattom Mosque. The history of that Kanjiramattom Mosque is the story of a Muslim boy receiving counsel. Even today, the flag hoisting at that mosque happens after this concludes. When the Sabarimala shrine closes, the rope brought from there is used for hoisting the flag at this mosque. So, all this stands as evidence before us. Then there is Cheerappanchira. What if you have no knowledge about this despite so much evidence? Having preserved it in a way that we cannot know about it, when they say that a situation was fabricated about Ayyappan claiming he was born when Hari and Suthan performed some deed, look at how much we have been manipulated. How vastly we have been played. We are the ones who have accepted numerous such denials. This is our summary. So, each one of us is the owner of this act of denial. Because you do not understand this, it keeps increasing daily. They call this devotion. How will you overcome this devotion? It is absolutely impossible. This cannot be grasped by everyone, except in front of the proponents of *Darshana* (philosophical vision). This *Darshana* must begin from the point that says, "In the universe, existence comes according to the course of action." So, how did creation happen in the beginning? How did it originate in the water? It is an evolutionary process that emerged from the light of the sun and the moon falling upon it. Humans are the result of this evolutionary process growing to this stage. Humans possess many kinds of flaws. *Darshana* is the process of seeking, knowing, and adopting this. So, what does that *Darshana* say? Starting from the fish, since it was in the water, we must understand that it happened quickly. If a human does not know this process—how it grew and reached the human incarnation, or at least how human development reached the stage of Vamana—what can be done? Thus, the ignorance that resides within us is cultivated by being tainted with numerous such flaws and portraying those legends exactly as they are. Now, it is from this that God has bestowed upon us the means to achieve. It has given prominence to women. Why is that? When a girl is born in our house, everyone knows how she is cared for. But today, you are putting on various displays. How do these householders (*Grihasthashramis*) make friends? Whether it is a family friend or a fund, I do not know, let it be whatever. So, this might be ten miles away. The next-door neighbors have no connection at all. Thus, searching for this and catching hold of it, they engage in these antics. What will they gain from this frantic dance? Ignorance. This ignorance is the great family fund here. It was a fund. Not of the present times. So, if asked why you carry around such vulgar behavior that has become so corrupted, you do not know. This was imported from somewhere. This was imported from British paramountcy. This is what you took to America and traded, associating yourselves with thieves. So, if these householders invite such a vulgar scene into our land, who are you? How should you be perceived? It is a difficult matter. Thus, it is said that this is the time destined by God for you to bring about a change in this. This is *Darshana*. So, how should you rise from this *Darshana*? When speaking of this *Darshana*, it is still not clear to you what you have understood about *Darshana*. Since when did this *Darshana* exist, since when did this *Manvantara* exist, and which Manu is in this *Manvantara*? Thus, corresponding to each *Manvantara*, the twenty-eighth *Chaturyuga* of this seventh Manu has arrived. But the moment the Trimurti system was introduced to it, from that day on, there is no *Manvantara*. Therefore, reclaim the history of that Manu. This is your fortune. Thus, know for yourselves what this Manu is. So, what did this Manu, belonging to the human race, do for us by standing in the position of a Guru since ancient times? When it was transformed into the world of Devas, the world of Rishis, and the world of imagination, all this went wrong. This became an error on the side of *Darshana*. However, we have to take responsibility for this error. Here lies the issue. We cannot move forward without rectifying this error. The proponents of *Darshana* must know this. What is called an error is the ignorance that each of us embodies, where our ancestors repeatedly learned and taught the mistakes of millions of years. How long has it been since this reached us? In order for us to reclaim this, our girls themselves must come straight to the forefront. Those girls must step forward and embrace a motherhood of this world. Otherwise, there is no point in merely coming as a girl and proceeding to the act of having ten children. Therefore, this girl must possess the exact qualities required of a mother. Likewise, the one who marries that girl must also have such knowledge. Only then can they gift a good offspring. So, for such an offspring, they must know what the Guru lineage is through this Guru lineage. They must know how such a Guru lineage became the Guru across epochs (*Kalantara Guru*). They must know what kinds of guidance are provided by such a *Kalantara Guru*. This is the bond of the Guru-disciple lineage. There is no use in living by segregating things into good and bad. This *Brahmaniveditham* is an inspiration for this to come into your midst. Thus, it is pointless to consider those who lack the innate aptitude of this child. This child will begin to see it. That is the truth. Having seen this, they must discover this within themselves through this Guru. Where is the source of this *Brahmagnana*? This is an explanation of the *Kalantara Guru*. Thus, they who are called man and woman are seeing it themselves. What is my Guru, and what am I? How do they share it with the world? It is not just a mere show. Thus, after the completion of the Vedas we speak of, there are these Mantra-Tantra Vedas they have laid out. After all these are exhausted, some of our Gurus themselves have written the Upanishads. Because all the learned scholars started off like that now, no one knows which one is this Upanishad. Thus, what is called this Upanishad is a proclamation of light. This Guru and disciple perceive this light by first showing any object and explaining how its origin happened, what its actions and duties are, and in what all colors it radiates. Only certain Upanishads mention that. Others exaggerate it and give meanings; that is commentary. What can be achieved through commentary? Thus, we have not been caught in such a fallacy just today or yesterday. It is a peril we have been trapped in for many ages. This corrupted our mind, word, and deed. If this is to be changed, it must return. How will it return? You speak of a *Chaturyuga*. Thus, how many *Chaturyugas* make a *Manvantara*? Similarly, you speak of this solar system. How many solar systems complete a *Manvantara*—there are calculations like this. If this calculation goes wrong, they cannot do anything.

We are attaining a lineage of thousands of sages. Showing them that the Truth exists is the divine resolve (*Brahmanishchayam*). Even after seeing this, if they do not remain truthful, they will become nothing in their karma. Why is this being shown? Mothers, girls, and fathers alike need to know this. They must know what has come according to the divine resolve in accordance with the duty of the age (*Yugadharma*). Otherwise, it is not merely a sight, a concept, or a prayer. Make these children understand that this was not attained because any of you prayed or did something else. So, they did not attain it by praying. If asked how this was attained; if this boy is getting it now, all you youngsters and children should bear in mind: this belongs to us. For that, I have suffered even severe beatings here—leave alone the abuses, but there are those who were beaten to death among them. Jesus is one among those who were included in being beaten to death. What is the purpose of the karma brought about by experiencing such immense sorrow? You may question, couldn't God just take this away? It cannot be taken away like that. Why? Human history has come through various paths, masquerading as good and bad. Up to where does this human have a karmic trajectory? How is he supposed to complete it? Thus, men and women must grow and become models for the world; these are children who need to know what this karma is. Instead, some of you householders (*Grihasthashramis*)—mostly it is the poor who say this—say with great arrogance, "Whatever happens, I have fulfilled my duty." What is it? Had a daughter and married her off. This is his karma! What is the use of this fool who thinks that everything is completed with this? No. I spoke wrongly. They did not see that it is only a part of their karma. Looking after one's father and mother. That is a part of his karma. Loving the neighbors. Welcoming guests. All these are his karma. Then what is it? The duty of a householder (*Grihadharma*) is the duty of taking one's soul to the Guru, purifying the soul through the Guru, and making it reach the state of Brahman. He does not understand this. He just wants to become worthless somehow. That is such a filthy way of karma. That is why I said, this is why God has given us this attire.

How should the ascetic (*Sanyasi*) that we need be? Growing up, even if that is not possible for him, he should at least fulfill the duties of a householder (*Grihasthashramadharma*). What is that? The duty of the home (*Grihadharma*), duty to ancestors (*Pitridharma*), duty to deities (*Devadharma*), duty of charity (*Danadharma*), and duty to the Self (*Atmadharma*). Then, whichever deities his ancestors or predecessors have been worshipping—he must become a householder capable of granting them liberation. Thus, men and women become the mother and father of the world. That is what is called 'Mata Pita Guru Daivam' (Mother, Father, Preceptor, God). So, we are struggling completely to bring them into such a karma. What is it? This dharma called karmic potential (*Karmashesi*) is a Truth served to the human world—you must fulfill that dharma. You need not fulfill it by merely talking about asceticism (*Sanyasa*). You must attain fulfillment through life completely, take up absolute knowledge as Guru and lineage, and impart the fulfillment of that action to the children. This is exactly what we intend by our *Brahmaniveditham*. You should not assume that they are all going to become ascetics. It is not like that. We should create the aspect of knowledge for them. Those who are destined will become that. What is the use of him if he does not become at least a good householder? Or what is the use of this woman? Now, in the name of being a good householder, there is a house wherever one goes. It would be like making one for the sake of renunciation. That is, a toddy tapper will have women and men in many places. Wherever he goes, there will be a marriage. Similarly, in the olden days, the great uncle would also have many marriages. We absolutely do not want a householder life like this. We must explain this to our children. That is why the ritual called Gurupooja is conducted here. Then we should tell them, children, it is like this—we did not get this. In your young age, a Guru lineage has come into existence in such a way as to make you understand what an ancestor (*Pitru*) is, what a deity (*Deva*) is, what a sage (*Rishi*) is, what a wise one (*Jnani*) is, and what a devotee (*Bhakta*) is. Here, you must fulfill this completely, dear child. You just need to do that much for us. You don't have to do anything else. Just save us. That means, whatever position this child reaches, that same position is attained by the father and mother. So, by nurturing it like this, for our third generation, you will see children growing up without being suffocated like this. Through you, this is being donated to the world. What is being shown is a small beginning of that.
Words of the Guru (*Guruvani*)

Dialogue between the Guru and the Disciple
Disciple: Does saying these nine planets mean nine steps?

Guru:- Nine states. You could say steps, if needed. That is nine skies. As being entitled to this, what they say in the Trinity (*Trimurti*) is twenty-seven stars, now for the Earth and the planets revolving around it. At the same time, we see millions of stars. All these are different descriptions. That is, these stars are individual souls. So, this is what they say, what is it? This Yogi. Nothing. *Neti, Neti, Neti* (Not this, Not this, Not this), the Vedantin. Merging and merging, he just ceases to exist. He is not merging away. He merged to the extent he grew. That is all. Then he became independent and left. Now the Yogi, having become independent, will just shine from there and remain there. There is no Guru.
Disciple:- Would the twenty-seven stars be great supreme souls (*Mahatmas*)?

Guru: That is the concept of Brahman (Brahmasankalpam). A Rishi, Sanyasi, Yogi, Jnani, Bhakta, and Karmi, one who has passed through like this, a perfected Guru. Each of these is a perfected star. Haven't many come like this since the world began? The one who enacts all this and departs is the one who comes as this Guru of the ages (Kalantara Guru). All this belongs to him. Otherwise, no one can go. These people lie like this ٹ That is why the frog is given as an example - the frog in the well.

So, one comes as the inheritor of an era (yuga). Now, don't they say - constellations. Because they stand here, when they go there, it is not there. Isn't this what they say? They are not fortunate enough to reach there. Then with what are they going to discover it? They cannot, and then they will say it does not exist. When they go there, they are not there. It is a period of many crores of years. Its time is over and it has become complete. Then one became the inheritor of a solar system. Only these twenty-seven stars will come. The others have no name. We see many stars now. It has taken many crores of years to reach our eyes. Only these twenty-seven stars are included in this calculation. That is the decree of Brahman (Brahmanischayam). One will see it to the extent of its vastness. Understood? A person came in the measure of a manvantara. Only that person can speak about the twenty-seven stars. Did you understand? So, there are twenty-seven stars within this one solar system.

Disciple:- The stars other than these twenty-seven are stars not according to the decree of Brahman. It was said they won't be seen when they go there. Are they taking birth or are they getting destroyed?
Guru:- They will stay and get destroyed. Some are grieving and doing penance from there, thinking, "I could not do anything."
Disciple:- A star would have its own time period, wouldn't it?

Guru:- Yes, it will. When it leaves a sky within a solar system, it changes. There are these twenty-seven centralized stars, right? The zodiac signs (rashis) of those twenty-seven stars are twelve. And nine planets. Once a life attains this, it will change. None of the others (stars) will attain it. Not a single one will attain it. These two thousand, three thousand, four thousand will not remain. It will stay for the time it is spoken of. Then it will go.
Disciple:- Then Carlos is asking how it comes down.
Guru:- You should observe and understand that. It is not something to be known by asking. You just see where the Guru stands like that. Otherwise, it is not something to be told.
Disciple:- That means the gods and goddesses and stars above us will change. They will change by themselves.

Guru:- Those are all different states. There is no need for us to mention all that. All that should be discarded. That is their concern. Why should we talk about it? In every way, the calculation is the same. But when it changes like this and each sky changes, now the earth is connected with the twenty-seven stars, twelve zodiac signs, and the nine planets. Once this life reaches this much, it will not come again. Brahman keeps it aside there. It is Brahman itself. It will be seen in all life. It is merging. When it is said it is kept aside, it means it is kept merged. When the required time comes, Brahman will bring it back again. Haven't you heard what Aravindan says? That he went and brought it back.
So, it comes as twenty-seven great souls (Mahatmas) for these twenty-seven stars.
Disciple:- When that one coming soul is sent as Brahman itself, does a set belonging to that soul come here?
Guru:- Yes, it comes. It does not come always. No one can know how it is decided by Brahman. When one goes by calculation, one goes wrong. That is why it is said that science goes wrong.
Disciple: So, will those who come along also be perfect like this?

Guru: Why should we know whether it is so? Didn't I tell you to observe and understand! Isn't it a job that misleads people? We should not say any of this publicly. Now, because you asked like this, I told you. So, once you grasp the power of one star, you will see all that. Thus, after seeing these twelve zodiac signs, the zodiac signs will come according to the calculation of these twenty-seven stars. Yes, it is the decree of Brahman. We don't have to look into any of that. Just say what was shown to us. That is the Guru and the disciple, we must always hold on like this. Otherwise, if you tie and wrap all this up like a bundle, it will just sit there. Aren't they showing mystical powers (siddhis)? If they don't go properly, they will not be able to show even the matter of these siddhis within this manvantara or this chaturyuga. They will just lie there. They won't be saved. How, why will they be saved from there? An evidence of that is Sathya Sai now. It is said he climbed six steps. It is true, the position of a Deva. Going there, they grasp all these Devas and turn them into siddhis. All those who showed these siddhis must do sit-ups (etham) in front of Brahman. Isn't etham done holding like this? So, each birth is for this one etham.

Now, when Jesus's disciples scooped up water, wasn't there a depression there? What is the use? There will be a depression in the water equal to what was scooped. If you scoop a handful of water from the sea, just because it gets depressed that much, will the water run out? That scooping means he will only see as far as his vision goes. How much will be visible to his eye? There is no point in talking big things. We don't need all this. You hold on to the Guru. Let what is attained be attained.
Disciple: The world began from seven Sanyasis. It was a Rishi sitting among them who conducted all this.

Guru: Yes. There is such a story. But we shouldn't hold onto it permanently. How do we know how the divine will (Brahmanishchayam) unfolds? We shouldn't say anything beyond that. So, whoever we see, we must speak of them. Everything exists. It is true. Fine, your mind only reaches that far, what can I do! Besides, do not tell him just to prove what we say is right. According to our knowledge - didn't you (Carlos) say that you were with the Guru for so many lifetimes? That itself will be useful to you in certain situations. Sometimes it won't be useful. You might not see anything. Sometimes you will get scolded. Sometimes you will get beaten. Sometimes you will get something else good. Sometimes you will be given grapes. Sometimes you will be given dog feces. We are not establishing authority by oppressing anything. We must grasp it ourselves and become the authority. This is the word in it. One will grow on one's own through action.

In the justice of God, they are being trampled underfoot. They are that vile. If we start trying to reform them, the world will not improve. And they are not acting this way to become better, either. They only want to accumulate as much violent tendency as possible. You might ask why God nurtures such vile practices. Doesn't God know? Can't God just close an eye or open an eye? You should not harbor such disgraceful ignorance. God does not stand by to open or close his eyes just because you or I say so. If there is such a special power, what is being spoken of is the philosophical perspective of the valor of action, which knows how this course of dharma was brought into this world. Who here can bestow such a philosophical vision upon them? It is never possible. They are the flawed performers of action (karmadoshis) who create a world of vile deeds. No one can reform them. What can stop the children of these people afflicted by the flaws of action? What will they hold within themselves? What have these people achieved other than being wretches who play with father, mother, children, husband, wife, wealth, dominance, and knowledge, and ultimately perish? If you take up and perform such filthy actions, who will stand by this flaw of action? Think! Think about the times of every birth and death. Your children get diseases, parents get diseases, gurus get diseases, and their disciples are killed off. Who can justify this ignorance that rules by destroying everyone? Who will take it where? What will the progeny of those afflicted by flawed karma achieve here? Think about it. Even if you destroy the world, you cannot escape from that action. The world only exists as long as this earth remains, right? This solar system can only do so much. There are thousands of solar systems like this. Scientists you see in the future will tell you. But they only want to say it; what they comprehend are things that happened in light-years or at some time in the past. Where will they end up? Which world are they setting out for? It is doubtful whether a single religious scholar or a single believer thinks about this. If all this is taken, measured, weighed, and given to do good for the world and humanity, it is only good for imposing on the heads of some poor people, causing their intellect to develop just enough to blaspheme God. Beyond that, they can do nothing. You must consider what this human world, which imparts such ignorance, should do. All the children in the world should consider it. It is of no use if only one or two people, or one caste or religion, think about it. The foundation of ignorance that proves that many people who develop their intellect like this and various violent individuals dying off is 'samadhi'! How can this be uprooted and planted elsewhere? Where will it be planted? Think! Every one of you is a mischievous being unable to see or respect even a fraction of what these great men and prophets suffered. The proof of this is the burial practices (kabaradakkam) copied from the stones in the yard to the stones in the forest, bringing them to the temple and the church, and taking it from there. If the core of such profound ignorance is snatched and kept in your hands, what can you do to this world? Not a single child can do anything. For that, there is a language nurtured as the progeny of each prophet: the Vaidikan, or the Tantri, or the Mantri, Yantri, Kuntri—all this is a mixture of all these together. If you do not stop this work, it would be better to put a knife to the necks of the children of all these people who act this way. You shouldn't raise them just to kill them. Kill them as soon as they are born.

In some places, if they see it's a girl, they will finish her off immediately. You all know this. So, in this world, who can do anything to you or your children, who hold the axe of this vile deed in your hands, brimming with offense and taking pleasure in this ignorance that serves and destroys with such 'knowledge'? Think! It is never to achieve this. The excess you do to your own life by getting caught in this transitional phase will absolutely lead to a birth that God will never permit. This is what is going to happen. Who can control the children of vile deeds? Having a little money and using it to wage religious wars, seeing that and waging caste wars, retrieving the flaws of action—how will you reform the oracles of such caste mischief? Think! I am only saying this much now. It is fine whether you think about it or not. It is fine whether you give anything to the world or not. Having spoken this truth to you, I will have no difficulty leaving this country or this world. The word of truth—you cannot destroy those words. They will not be destroyed if set on fire, they will not rot in water, they cannot be shattered by thunder and rain. You will be born as the very basic natures of absolutely complete flawed action. God will not let you go in any way. If you consciously perform action and fail, no one can hold you back. Who can destroy, and how, this action that has been corrupted by what is suppressed by the Vaidikans and Sanyasis, mentioned in the foundational texts like Manusmriti or something else? But it will be destroyed like this. A flaw of action where not even a speck of rust can hide in this world is a truth that none of you can ever set aside. For the sake of this action, by making you perform Guru Pooja and having it performed—not for any caste or religion. Not to remove any flaw of action. For the growth of your children; to prevent vile karma from joining their progeny, and to give liberation to ancestors or prophets if they somehow fell into error. Not to reform these so-called pseudo-nationalists. It is fine if they improve, and fine if they perish. Let them go their way. This word will be the truth, forever. Remember!

Now, I am telling you about the magnitude of the virtues and vices that we and our ancestors have accumulated up to this day. Otherwise, contemplate what you will become if you fail to attain the merit that comes through prayer here and the blessings granted by God, which grow and multiply through you. Those standing inside and outside know this in many ways. You must think, act, and apply this in your life's path, preserving without losing this dharma given by God to pass on to your children. It is not you or I who should measure the fruit and fulfillment of your prayers thus far. I can only convey the words I receive to you. It is you—father, mother, children, husband, and wife—who must understand and act upon them. Without letting it decay into mere wealth, dominance, and worldly knowledge, what I have explained is the weight of the traditional wisdom of children, where every single atom transforms into seeds to do dharma for the world. You should embrace it if you are capable of doing so. Isn't that so? God has shown all this to you. Today, most believers—by believers, do not assume it means only the believers here, but believers anywhere, belonging to any Guru lineage—are receiving proof of this. They will pass it on to the children to come. Understanding this, everyone should complete their lives with happiness. This is all I have to say.
You should never discard through flaws that dharma, comprising the good and the bad, which God has served and integrated into your being; preserve it with goodness.
Guruvani
